Ongoing Topics covered: Sponsor’s responsibilities, Reporting time frames, Minimum criteria for reporting, How to report, Informing Investigators, IEC/IRB for new of new safety information, Development of Safety Update Report.  2.3.2 Disease Specific Knowledge Acquired Through the daily practice, the interaction with collaborators, reading documents in the library and online literature review, I have developed and consolidated knowledge on the: -­‐ Overall architecture and detailed elements of a clinical development plan and of clinical trial preparation and implementation. -­‐ Design of clinical trial on infectious diseases, -­‐ Epidemiology and immunology of Cholera, -­‐ Epidemiology and immunology of Typhoid Fever, -­‐ Epidemiology and immunology of Dengue Fever.  2.3.3 Integration/Contribution in the Team In order to apply my theoretical knowledge, to develop and consolidate practical skills in clinical trial, I was involved and I have contributed to different activities of Clinical Trials and Regulatory Department of IVI.   More specifically, I was part of the clinical team of a Cholera Vaccine Trial, sponsored by IVI and conducted at the International Centre for Diarrheal Diseases Research in Bangladesh (ICDDR, B) in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I am also part of clinical team of a Typhoid Conjugate Vaccine manufactured by SK Chemicals, Republic of Korea, and tested in the Philippines.   The different activities in the framework of this clinical trial are: • Participation to the project team meetings to understand the management of the research project and regulatory pathway. • Development of protocol and related trial documents • Visit of Incepta Pharmaceuticals in Bangladesh, manufacturer of the cholera vaccine (Cholvax): visit of the plant, general overview on the vaccine production process and discussion of the licensure strategy.
